event_name: Time 12:52 2019 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 October 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 23), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The gearbox of car 20 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired. This Penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start the race from the rear of starting grid for failing to set a time in qualifying.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 20 Gearbox
to: The Team Manager, Haas F1 Team
